verdict.rationale: FireHydrant Signals documents alert rules that turn matching events into alerts and route them through escalation policies, plus alerting analytics. Nothing in the pack describes deduplicating duplicate alerts or grouping related alerts into one incident or page. Rule matching and analytics 'group by' are adjacent features, not alert deduplication or grouping, so the applicable axis is unevidenced.

support.subject: As an SRE, duplicate and related alerts are deduplicated and grouped so one incident pages one human, not fifty
